name: Tag high-confidence C2 addresses
description: When an ip-src or ip-dst attribute arrives with to_ids set, tag its event so the SOC queue picks it up. Seeded paused: enabling it and adding an attribute is a better demo than finding it has already run, and an active script would otherwise tag existing events as a side effect of seeding.

name: Log newly published events
description: A minimal read-only script: writes a line to the run log every time an event is published. Good first example because it cannot change anything.
source:
def handle(ctx, payload, trigger):
    ctx.log(
        "event published",
        payload.get("event_uuid"),
        "by",
        (payload.get("orgc") or {}).get("name"),
    )
